counterfactual_missing_items: compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene

decisive_items: compound heterozygous sequence variation in GGCX gene
Low clotting activity of factor X (52.2%; reference range, 77%-131%)
Prolonged prothrombin time (12.8 seconds; reference range, 10.4-12.6 seconds)
response.rationale: R1 is the only candidate whose raw evidence includes the decisive GGCX compound heterozygosity, and it uniquely accounts for the low factor X and prolonged PT that explain the PXE-like skin and histology. R2 matches the skin phenotype and elastic-fiber calcification but omits the genetic and coagulation evidence and is further disfavored by normal fundoscopy/echo. C1 is a correlated anatomy-restricted restatement of R2, while R4 is too nonspecific.

rejected.why: Cutis laxa is a generic descriptor and does not explain yellowish papules, elastic-fiber calcification, GGCX variants, or factor X deficiency.
Append-only completion of R2 with an anatomy modifier; adds no independent raw evidence and still omits the decisive GGCX and coagulation findings.
